_note: Golden reel 3 of 3: Guess the Tamil Movie (Kaithi), rebuilt from a plan. Clues are objects and places, never faces or the title.

lead.topic: Kaithi (2019): biryani and handcuffs, one night and a lorry, a forest police station

images.prompt: A big steel plate heaped with steaming chicken biryani and boiled eggs on a dark wooden table in a night-time roadside eatery, a pair of old steel handcuffs lying open in the foreground beside the plate, rain and teal neon glow in the blurred background

An old orange Indian lorry driving alone on a wet forest highway at night, headlights cutting through fog, tall dark trees and coconut palms on both sides, puddles reflecting the lights, deep blue night with warm headlight glow

A small old colonial-era police station with a tiled roof and iron-barred gate, deep in a dark forest at night, one warm yellow lamp glowing inside the open doorway, stone steps in front, mist between the trees

caption.text:
3 clues. Oru Tamil padam. Kandupidikka mudiyumaa?
Biryani, kaivilangu, oru lorry, oru raathiri.
Endha clue-la kandupidicheenga: 1, 2, illa 3?
Unga cinema friend-a test pannunga.
